title: AYPOW Fleece Balaclava — Hat, Face Mask & Neck Warmer in One
short_description: Warm two-layer balaclava: acrylic fibre outside, soft fleece inside. Wear it as a hat, ski mask or neck warmer, one size for 52–59 cm head circumference — for winter camping, skiing and hiking.
long_description: The AYPOW balaclava (model LPA017-P) has a two-layer design: durable acrylic fibre outside and a soft fleece lining inside which, according to the manufacturer, blocks cold wind and adds warmth. Thanks to its elasticity, it fits most head circumferences from 52 to 59 cm. The semi-open design can be worn as a balaclava, ski mask, neck warmer or scarf and covers the ears, neck and most of the cheeks. Ideal for winter camping, skiing, snowboarding, hiking, cycling or fishing. Care: hand wash recommended, do not bleach, dry in the shade.
features: Balaclava, ski mask or neck warmer
Lightweight, no pressure on the head
buying_angle: Practical for anyone who wants to keep head, ears and neck warm with a single piece while winter camping, skiing or hiking.
